explanation: Lorenzo de' Medici took the teenage Michelangelo into his palace. Later Medici included popes, such as Leo X and Clement VII, and two queens of France.

claims.text: The Medici family of bankers dominated Florence for much of the 1400s and 1500s and were patrons of Botticelli.
The Borgias were based in Rome and Spain, the Sforzas ruled Milan and the Fuggers were bankers in Augsburg; none ruled Florence.
Lorenzo de' Medici brought the teenage Michelangelo into his household in Florence.
Popes Leo X and Clement VII were members of the Medici family.
Two Medici women, Catherine and Marie, became queens of France.
